endorsements.name: Ismael Pacheco Torrecilla
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-29732
endorsements.description: A SQL Injection has been found on SCAN_VISIO eDocument Suite Web Viewer of Abast. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated user to retrieve, update and delete all the information of database. This vulnerability was found on login page via "user" parameter.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)

endorsements.name: Ismael Pacheco Torrecilla
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-1175
endorsements.description: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Kelio Visio 1, Kelio Visio X7 and Kelio Visio X4, in versions between 3.2C and 5.1K. This vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute a JavaScript payload by making a POST request and injecting malicious code into the editable ‘username’ parameter of the ‘/PageLoginVisio.do’ endpoint.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.1)
